biological_question: Is MMP11 transcript abundance altered in LUAD?
qualitative_result: MMP11 was the highest-upregulated MMP in the joint analysis.
quantitative_result: Four GEO cohorts; source-native fold estimates shown in Figure 1
source_location: Figure 1; Results: MMP11 Is Significantly Upregulated
major_limitation: Joint reanalysis combines heterogeneous GEO cohorts; not four independent evidence votes.

biological_question: Does TCGA-LUAD reproduce tumour-associated expression?
qualitative_result: TCGA analysis showed higher tumour expression.
major_limitation: Shares TCGA-LUAD biological data lineage with Task #039A; not independent replication.

biological_question: Where is MMP11 protein observed in LUAD tissue?
qualitative_result: Strong staining was described in transformed cancer cells with little or no staining in adjacent stroma.
major_limitation: Small cohort; staining assessment and selection details limit generalization.

biological_question: Is circulating MMP11 higher in patients with LUAD?
qualitative_result: Serum MMP11 was higher in the LUAD group.
major_limitation: Small cross-sectional cohort; diagnostic specificity was not established.

biological_question: Does MMP11 depletion alter LUAD-cell proliferation?
qualitative_result: MMP11 depletion reduced proliferation-related readouts.
major_limitation: Single cell line for this evidence unit; CRISPR off-target and clonal effects require consideration.

biological_question: Does MMP11 depletion alter AKT phosphorylation?
qualitative_result: Phosphorylated AKT was reduced after depletion.
major_limitation: Downstream readout does not establish a complete causal pathway.

biological_question: Can MMP11 re-expression partially restore proliferation phenotypes?
intervention_or_perturbation: MMP11 depletion then transient MMP11 expression
qualitative_result: Depletion-associated reductions were reported as partially rescued.
quantitative_result: Source figure; no single aggregate effect
major_limitation: Transient rescue and source-text wording inconsistencies require cautious interpretation.

biological_question: Does MMP11 depletion alter migration/invasion?
qualitative_result: Migration/invasion readouts decreased; rescue was partial.
quantitative_result: A549 invasion approximately 60% lower; n=3-5 by assay
major_limitation: Assays share cell systems and publication; migration assays are not metastasis outcomes.

biological_question: Does an anti-MMP11 antibody alter LUAD-cell growth?
qualitative_result: Growth inhibition was reported from 1 microgram/mL.
major_limitation: Reagent specificity and translational pharmacology were not independently established.

biological_question: Does an anti-MMP11 antibody alter migration?
qualitative_result: Migration decreased with antibody exposure.
major_limitation: Same antibody and cell systems as other paper experiments; not an independent replication.

biological_question: Does MMP11 depletion alter xenograft growth?
model_system: A549 xenograft in female BALB/c nude mice
qualitative_result: Control tumours were reported approximately four times larger at day 30.
major_limitation: Subcutaneous immunodeficient-mouse model does not establish patient efficacy.

biological_question: Does anti-MMP11 antibody exposure alter xenograft growth?
model_system: A549 xenograft in female BALB/c nude mice
intervention_or_perturbation: 1 mg/kg IV every four days, four administrations
qualitative_result: Antibody treatment reduced tumour growth.
major_limitation: Preclinical model only; efficacy, specificity, exposure, and safety require further study.

biological_question: Is MMP11 higher in LUAD and EGFR-mutant LUAD?
qualitative_result: MMP11 was higher in tumour and modestly higher in EGFR-mutant cases.
quantitative_result: 512 cases with known EGFR status; 59 normals
statistical_result: Tumour vs normal p<0.001; mutant vs wild type p<0.05
major_limitation: Shares TCGA-LUAD lineage with Task #039A and the 2019 TCGA reanalysis.

biological_question: Does MMP11 differ across EGFR mutation subtypes?
comparator: Exon 19 deletion, L858R, uncommon, compound subtypes
qualitative_result: No overall difference among EGFR-mutant subtypes was reported.
major_limitation: Small subtype groups and shared TCGA cohort.

biological_question: Is MMP11 protein higher in EGFR-mutant LUAD?
qualitative_result: Higher MMP11 IHC was reported in EGFR-mutant cases.
major_limitation: Single-centre small retrospective cohort.

biological_question: Is MMP11 associated with activated CD8 and NK-cell estimates?
qualitative_result: High-MMP11 cases had lower estimated activated CD8 and NK-cell abundance.
major_limitation: Computational estimates from shared bulk TCGA data do not establish mechanism.

biological_question: Are CD8/NK observations reproduced in tissue?
qualitative_result: Tumour parenchyma with MMP11 positivity showed lower CD8/NK staining.
major_limitation: Spatial association in the same clinical cohort is not causal.

biological_question: Is MMP11 correlated with cytotoxic T-cell level?
qualitative_result: No statistically significant correlation was reported.
major_limitation: Computational estimate; shared TCGA dataset.

biological_question: Is MMP11 associated with clinical benefit of immune-checkpoint blockade?
qualitative_result: No significant association with clinical benefit was reported.
major_limitation: TIDE is a computational predictor, not a prospective treatment cohort.

biological_question: Is MMP11 associated with TIDE score?
qualitative_result: Higher TIDE scores were reported in the high-MMP11 group.
major_limitation: Predicted response metric must not be represented as observed clinical efficacy.

biological_question: Is MMP11 transcript abundance higher in lung-cancer datasets?
qualitative_result: MMP11 was elevated in all three reanalysed datasets.
major_limitation: Only GSE32863 is LUAD-specific; other datasets include squamous or mixed histology.

biological_question: Is tissue MMP11 higher in adenocarcinoma than adjacent normal?
qualitative_result: Adenocarcinoma tissue had higher MMP11 than adjacent normal.
major_limitation: Small tissue cohort; assay localization not resolved.

biological_question: Is serum MMP11 higher in NSCLC than controls?
qualitative_result: Serum MMP11 was higher in NSCLC.
quantitative_result: 200 NSCLC vs 200 controls; medians 40.55 vs 16.01 ng/mL
major_limitation: Primary comparison combines adenocarcinoma and squamous cases.

biological_question: Does serum MMP11 distinguish adenocarcinoma from squamous NSCLC?
qualitative_result: Serum MMP11 was lower in adenocarcinoma than squamous cases.
major_limitation: Cross-sectional assay does not establish disease mechanism.

biological_question: Is MMP11 observed among variable myofibroblast genes in LUAD?
qualitative_result: MMP11 was one of three high-variance myofibroblast genes.
major_limitation: Marker assignment is cell-state association, not target causality.

biological_question: Was MMP11 associated with LUAD prognosis in the tested signature genes?
qualitative_result: Among CTHRC1, POSTN and MMP11, only POSTN correlated with prognosis.
major_limitation: Source focuses mechanistically on POSTN, not MMP11.

biological_question: Is an MMP11-positive myofibroblast state reported in a LUAD-resolved pan-cancer analysis?
model_system: Human pan-cancer single-cell datasets with LUAD-resolved analysis
qualitative_result: The bladder-primary publication reported an MMP11-positive myofibroblast state in its LUAD-resolved pan-cancer analysis.
major_limitation: The publication's primary experimental context is bladder cancer; no MMP11 perturbation was performed in LUAD.

biological_question: Is MMP11 among upregulated genes in a paired lung-cancer cohort?
qualitative_result: MMP11 was included among 39 upregulated genes.
major_limitation: Publication does not fully resolve LUAD histology for every sample.

biological_question: Is high MMP11 associated with survival in the queried lung cohort?
qualitative_result: High MMP11 was associated with lower survival.
major_limitation: Underlying cohort composition and accession are not fully traceable in the paper.

biological_question: Which genes are altered in LUAD with low USP15?
qualitative_result: MMP11 was among significantly upregulated genes.
major_limitation: Very small cohort; MMP11 was not directly perturbed.

biological_question: Does miR-25/KLF4 perturbation alter MMP11 readout?
qualitative_result: MMP11 decreased with miR-25 inhibition and increased in the reciprocal context.
major_limitation: MMP11 was a downstream readout and was not itself perturbed; Calu-1 is not LUAD.

biological_question: Do LUAD tumour-derived MSCs display an MMP11-positive CAF-like phenotype?
model_system: MSCs from one LUAD patient plus A549 co-culture
qualitative_result: MMP11 was among CAF-related markers higher in tumour-derived MSCs.
major_limitation: Single-patient stromal model; MMP11-specific functional contribution was not tested.

biological_question: Are four MMP11 promoter variants associated with lung-cancer susceptibility?
qualitative_result: No association was found for rs738791, rs2267029, rs738792, or rs28382575.
statistical_result: rs738791 trend p=0.5638; other tests null
major_limitation: Histology-specific LUAD estimates were not reported.

biological_question: Is SPOCK1 expression correlated with MMP11 in NSCLC tissue?
qualitative_result: SPOCK1 overexpression was positively correlated with MMP11 and TGF-beta1.
major_limitation: MMP11 was not perturbed and LUAD histology was not separated.

experimental_modality: lncRNA knockdown and MMP11 overexpression rescue
biological_question: Can MMP11 overexpression offset effects of linc00511 silencing?
intervention_or_perturbation: linc00511 knockdown; miR-16-5p inhibition or MMP11 overexpression
qualitative_result: MMP11 overexpression was reported to offset suppressive effects of linc00511 silencing.
major_limitation: Cell-line identity and LUAD histology are not explicit enough in accessible source text.

biological_question: Does alectinib treatment alter Mmp11 in stromal cells?
qualitative_result: CAFs substantially upregulated Mmp11 during alectinib treatment.
major_limitation: MMP11 was not perturbed; histology and species/source-cell distinctions limit LUAD inference.

biological_question: Is MMP11 among shared COPD/LUAD/LUSC expression features?
qualitative_result: MMP11 was identified among 15 shared DEGs and as a network hub.
major_limitation: Reuses GSE10072 and GSE18842; network hub status is not causal evidence.

biological_question: Does cirsimarin exposure alter MMP11 transcript in A549 cells?
qualitative_result: Cirsimarin reduced migration and multiple genes including MMP11.
major_limitation: Multi-target, partly cytotoxic exposure; no MMP11 mediation or direct binding test.

biological_question: Does nintedanib exposure alter MMP11 in non-tumour lung?
model_system: Non-tumour lung from NSCLC patients with interstitial pneumonia
qualitative_result: MMP11 was upregulated in non-tumour lung after nintedanib.
major_limitation: Non-tumour fibrotic/inflammatory tissue context; not evidence of LUAD-tumour response.

biological_question: Is MMP11 higher in resected NSCLC than matched normal lung?
qualitative_result: MMP11 was increased in tumour tissue.
quantitative_result: Average tumour:normal ratio 83.5; 30 matched pairs within 119 cases
major_limitation: Mixed NSCLC histologies; LUAD-specific estimate unavailable.

biological_question: Is MMP11 tumour:normal ratio associated with lymph-node involvement?
qualitative_result: Higher ratio was linked to nodal involvement.
major_limitation: Mixed histology and observational association.

biological_question: Where is MMP11 expressed in lung carcinomas?
qualitative_result: MMP11 was more often stromal; 23 adenocarcinomas were included.
major_limitation: Key MMP11 associations were not stratified for adenocarcinoma.

biological_question: Is stromal MMP11 associated with tumour size or nodal involvement?
qualitative_result: Stromal MMP11 was linked to tumour size and nodal involvement.
major_limitation: Non-NE aggregate, not LUAD-specific.

biological_question: Is MMP11 more abundant in NSCLC than adjacent normal lung?
qualitative_result: Transcript and protein were more abundant in NSCLC.
major_limitation: Histology-specific estimates unavailable.

biological_question: Which compartment contains MMP11 in NSCLC?
qualitative_result: MMP11 was primarily localized to stromal elements.
major_limitation: Mixed histology and historical assay context.

biological_question: Is stromal MMP11 associated with cancer-related survival in stage-I NSCLC?
qualitative_result: The source described a near-significant relation, not a significant result.
statistical_result: Near-significant; exact p not in abstract
major_limitation: Mixed histology; treating near-significance as supportive would be misleading.

biological_question: Is MMP11 consistently higher in recurrent stage-IB lung cancer?
qualitative_result: MMP11 was up in one recurrent case; only MMP10 and MMP12 validated as significant group findings.
major_limitation: Small mixed-histology cohort; MMP11 was not a validated recurrence marker.

biological_question: Is MMP11 upregulated in lung adenocarcinoma tissue?
qualitative_result: MMP11 was reported among genes upregulated in both histologies.
major_limitation: Small cohort and historical profiling platform.

biological_question: Is MMP11 higher in stage II than stage I NSCLC?
qualitative_result: MMP11 was reported higher in stage II.
major_limitation: Mixed 33 squamous, 23 adenocarcinoma, and 8 other cases; no LUAD-stratified result.

biological_question: Can NSCLC cells induce MMP11 secretion by pulmonary fibroblasts?
qualitative_result: Co-culture induced fibroblast MMP11 secretion; processing context was assessed.
major_limitation: Histology unresolved; model does not isolate LUAD-specific signalling.

biological_question: Which PKC pathways mediate tumour-cell induction of fibroblast MMP11?
qualitative_result: PKC-alpha and PKC-epsilon were required for MMP11 induction.
major_limitation: Histology unresolved; stromal induction model is not direct tumour-cell dependency.

biological_question: Does betaTrCP restoration alter active MMP11 and motility?
qualitative_result: Active MMP11 and motility decreased after betaTrCP restoration.
major_limitation: MMP11 was downstream and not directly perturbed; LUAD identity unresolved.

biological_question: How is MMP11 placed in a computed SPP1 upstream network?
qualitative_result: MMP11 appeared in different inferred modules/edge directions between contexts.
major_limitation: Underlying dataset and inferred edges require source-specific reconstruction; no causal perturbation.

biological_question: Is MMP11 expression observed in smoking-stratified LUAD vs normal comparisons?
qualitative_result: The primary dataset supports LUAD-versus-normal contrasts used by downstream reanalyses.
major_limitation: Task #039B preserves the source record but does not recompute expression statistics.

biological_question: Is a primary LUAD-versus-normal transcriptomic dataset available?
qualitative_result: A LUAD-versus-normal source record is present in the frozen Open Targets/Expression Atlas lineage.
major_limitation: Array accession is not GEO; raw values were not retrieved in this task.

biological_question: Is a LUAD development-related transcriptomic cohort available?
qualitative_result: A LUAD-versus-normal source record is present in the frozen Open Targets/Expression Atlas lineage.
major_limitation: Developmental and tumour contexts are mixed; Task #039B does not recompute contrasts.
